_comment: Quest-gated form purchases. Key each entry by the lower-cased DMZ form-skill name (as in getFormSkills, e.g. 'superform'). questId: saga quests are '<sagaId>:<questNumericId>', side quests use their string id. gateUpgrades=false gates only the first buy (level 0->1); true also gates every upgrade while the quest is incomplete. The form keeps its normal TP price - the quest only unlocks the ability to buy. Delete the '_example' entry (it is ignored) and add real ones under 'gates'.
